research_interests: Current manuscript (Water Resources Research): how solar PV integration with a large storage reservoir (hydro-solar complementary operation) changes reservoir storage, turbine releases, additional spill and environmental-flow releases; how the timing of PV-induced reductions in turbine releases relative to reservoir refill, flood-season storage limits and operating rules (rule curves, target water levels) determines whether retained water is later spilled or released through turbines; physical turbine discharge capacity versus operating-rule constraints; water-balance accounting of 'water saved' by PV. Rate High only for papers on hydro-solar/wind complementary operation, reservoir spill or curtailment, reservoir operating rules or refill under renewable integration, or hydropower water accounting. Broader interests (Medium at most): hydropower flexibility, drought risks to hydropower grids, water-energy trade-offs; transferable mechanisms preferred over single-site case studies.
filter_policy: direct hydropower (incl. hydro-solar/wind hybrids and spill) OR (reservoir/water-management AND specific power-system terms) OR (climate extreme AND specific power-system terms AND water)
